LESSON: HADITH ON SWALAH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH
Topic 4.1: Hadith on swalah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on swalah. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Mention times of the five obligatory prayers .
2. Perform the five daily prayers on their prescribed time.
3. Appreciate the importance of performing the five dailyICT. prayers on time to earn  Learners are guided on the importance rewards from Allah.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Mention times of the five obligatory prayers .
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention times of the five obligatory prayers . Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Perform the five daily prayers on their prescribed time.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to perform the five daily prayers on their prescribed time. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate the importance of performing the five dailyICT. prayers on time to earn  Learners are guided on the importance rewards from Allah.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of performing the five dailyICT. prayers on time to earn  Learners are guided on the importance rewards from Allah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on swalah.
2. Explain Hadith on swalah to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on swalah.
4. Show that you can: Mention times of the five obligatory prayers .
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on swalah. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Hadith on swalah important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Mention times of the five obligatory prayers .
2. Perform the five daily prayers on their prescribed time.
3. Appreciate the importance of performing the five dailyICT. prayers on time to earn  Learners are guided on the importance rewards from Allah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
